text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy: release v1.20.0 -> prod (change window 01:30-03:30 UTC). Feature flag 'predictor_v2' toggled ON for canary at 5% across regions. Planned ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 40m. React +1 to proceed, :warning: to hold.
jess: +1 to go but watch p95 and error budget closely. I'll run smoke suite against v1.20.0 canary.
ram: smoke started. small uptick in client 502s around 01:38, nothing widespread yet. Tailing logs.
olivia: checking traces - I see increased tail latency originating from model-gateway-eu. Sample trace IDs: `trace-9f2a`, `trace-9f2b`. Looks like model-host-12 hitting high GC and dropping connections.
taylor: ops, FYI model-host-12 is on the older instance generation, might be underprovisioned for v2.0. We should limit EU weight until we confirm.
ops-bot: Auto-alert: prod-eu error-rate crossed 1.2% at 01:40 UTC. Threshold configured 1.0%.
jess: hold ramp. Set EU weight to 0% and keep us at 5% canary. We'll pin routing in eu to v1.19.5 for safety.
deploy-bot: Action taken: predictor_v2 -> set 0% in prod-eu; predictor_v2 remains at 5% in prod-us. Routing pin applied: model-gateway -> pinned v1.19.5 for shards eu-*. To rollback routing: `/deploy routing-rollback model-gateway v1.19.5` (ops-only).
ram: opened GH #4286: "predictor_v2: GC-induced connection drops on model-host-12 (EU) during canary" with logs attached. Draft release-note line: "Paused predictor_v2 EU ramp due to model-host GC spikes; EU routing pinned to v1.19.5."
olivia: ops is restarting model-host-12 under a maintenance cordon, migrating load to newer hosts. If GC stabilizes within 8m, propose a slow EU-only probe at 1% -> 3%.
taylor: agree. Also recommend adding a temporary autoscaling knob for model-hosts in EU while we investigate. Can we do hotfix scale?
ops-bot: Executing hot scale: `./infra/scale_hosts.sh --pool eu-models --add 2` (initiated).
deploy-bot: Scheduled probe: EU probe 1% -> 3% over 8m, but only after manual ack in this thread. Automated rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.0% OR p95 latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
jess: ack to proceed with the managed probe when ops confirms hosts added. Also please append final release note: "Ramped predictor_v2 in US to 5% (canary); EU ramp paused and pinned to previous version pending host remediation."
ram: hosts added and cordon lifted. Ops ran GC tuning patch on model-host-12. If green for 10m, we'll try EU probe.
olivia: 5m steady with error-rate back under 0.5% and p95 180ms. OK to try 1% probe.
taylor: executing command: `./ffctl ramp predictor_v2 --region eu --from 0 --to 1 --step 1 --wait 300`
deploy-bot: EU probe started: 0% -> 1% over 5m. Monitoring hooks enabled. Next auto-check in +6m. :eyes:
ops-bot: Reminder: operator-only rollback commands: `/deploy revert release v1.20.0` or `/deploy routing-rollback model-gateway v1.19.5`. Use ops channel for manual rollbacks.
jess: thanks everyone. Keeping thread live for release-note final copy and incident follow-up. After probe stabilizes we will continue ramp plan but with EU slow-path: 1% -> 5% -> 20% only if sustained for 15m at each step.
ram: release-note final: "predictor_v2: canary deployed to 5% in US; EU ramp paused due to GC spikes on model hosts. EU routing pinned to v1.19.5 until hosts are remediated. Subsequent EU ramp to follow conservative slow-path. Incident: GH #4286." :white_check_mark:
